per_depth.common_affordance: direct presentation of 2-SAT clauses via signed integers representing literals
The direct representation of rules as pairs of signed integers (DIMACS literal style) requiring at least one to be satisfied, identical to textbook 2-SAT.
The explicit disjunctive pair structure (not A and not B -> breach, meaning A or B must hold) mapping directly to 2-CNF clauses
The direct description of the constraint as a directed conditional failover rule (¬A ⇒ B and ¬B ⇒ A), directly giving away the 2-SAT implication graph structure.
